statement.text:
(a) Recover the Jones polynomial of links $L \subset \mathbb{R}^{3}$ by counting solutions to
the Kapustin–Witten equations on $\mathbb{R}^{3} \times \mathbb{R}_{+}$ with Nahm pole boundary
conditions;
(b) Recover the Khovanov homology of links $L \subset \mathbb{R}^{3}$ by counting solutions to
the Haydys–Witten equations on $\mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R}^{3} \times \mathbb{R}_{+}$ with Nahm pole boundary
conditions;

(c) Use the Kapustin–Witten or Haydys–Witten equations to construct invari-
ants of links in other 3-manifolds.
